Research plan

Your group's first job is to fill in
[`research-plan.md`]({{PLAN}}).
Each section has its own sub-issue below, so that each piece of work has
an owner and can be reviewed on its own.

1. **Share out the sections.** Open each sub-issue and choose an
   **Assignee** in the right-hand sidebar.
2. **Work on a branch, then open a pull request.** Each sub-issue
   explains how.
3. **Close this issue** once every section has been merged and the whole
   group agrees the plan hangs together.
